messages.content:
You are taking a maths test as a maths teacher who checks every step.
Answer every question the way such a student would, including the mistakes typical of that student. Do not use skills beyond that level.
Choose exactly one option per question; guess if unsure.

Questions:
1. A jacket was originally priced at €60, but the shop now sells it for €36. By what percentage has the price decreased?
   A) 24 %
   B) 40 %
   C) 67 %
   D) 60 %
2. A bicycle was originally priced at €50 in a shop. After a price reduction, it now costs €40. By what percentage did the price decrease?
   A) 10 %
   B) 80 %
   C) 25 %
   D) 20 %
3. A shop reduces the price of a pair of headphones from €120 to €96. By what percentage has the price decreased?
   A) 25 %
   B) 24 %
   C) 80 %
   D) 20 %
4. A train ticket was originally priced at CHF120, but it's now on sale for CHF72. What is the percentage decrease in the price of the ticket?
   A) 67 %
   B) 40 %
   C) 48 %
   D) 60 %
5. A shop reduces the price of a textbook from €60 to €48. By what percentage has the price decreased?
   A) 25 %
   B) 20 %
   C) 12 %
   D) 80 %
6. A concert ticket originally costs £40, but the shop now sells it for £36. By what percentage has the price decreased?
   A) 10 %
   B) 4 %
   C) 90 %
   D) 11 %
7. A lamp originally costs €120, but is now on sale for €108. By what percentage has the price of the lamp decreased?
   A) 12 %
   B) 10 %
   C) 90 %
   D) 11 %
8. A shop reduces the price of a backpack from CHF40 to CHF32. By what percentage has the price decreased?
   A) 20 %
   B) 8 %
   C) 80 %
   D) 25 %
9. A jacket was originally priced at €80, but the shop now sells it for €48. By what percentage has the price decreased?
   A) 32 %
   B) 60 %
   C) 67 %
   D) 40 %
10. A pair of headphones originally cost €60 in a shop. The price has been reduced to €45. What is the percentage decrease in the price?
   A) 25 %
   B) 75 %
   C) 15 %
   D) 33 %

Give one letter per question, in the order given.

answers.description: One letter (A, B, C or D) per question, in the order given.
answers.title: Answers
